newsitem.title: UK: CE says Entergy had chance for Northern bid.
newsitem.headline: CE says Entergy had chance for Northern bid.

text.p: CE Electric, majority owned by CalEnergy, said on Wednesday that U.S. power firm Entergy had had the opportunity to submit an offer for Northern Electric, which CE is bidding for, but had decided not to.

Entergy earlier announced an agreed 1.267 billion stg bid for London Electricity, prompting statements from both CE Electric and its target in the sector Northern Electric, for which it has made a 650 pence final cash offer.
"According to newspaper reports, Entergy has previously held talks with Northern Electric," CE Electric said in a statement.
But CE's bid target Northern said a newspaper report that Entergy might have made a bid for it was "idle speculation".

"Entergy had the opportunity to submit an offer for Northern Electric at a price of more than 650 pence per share but chose not to. Apparently, paying more than 650p...was less attractive to (it) than acquiring London Electricity on the announced terms," CE Electric said.
